title: Golden Bear RV Park

services.name: Camping Cabins
services.desc: Introducing our brand new Lancaster cabins featuring waterfront covered porches! Both are nestled perfectly up to the riverfront. It doesn't get better than this! These camping cabins are approximately 360 sq/ft with full bath, heating/cooling. Both cabins, Salmon and Bear, sleep 6: 1 double futon couch, 2 twins (bunks) and 1 queen bed. There is a no smoking policy which extends to vaping and the use of recreational marijuana and other drugs (legal or otherwise). We are a family friendly park and we want to keep the enclosed common areas and cabins free of smoke and drugs. Silverware, bakeware, pots and pans... Whatever you need is provided. Just bring groceries and settle
